rationale: The agent verified the user by matching full name and zip code to a single profile before proceeding. It retrieved the correct delivered order details and checked product variant availability. It correctly informed the user that no full-size clicky RGB keyboard variant was available and offered valid alternatives. It then explicitly asked for confirmation before making any order-changing action. Upon the user’s confirmation to exchange only the thermostat, the agent performed the exchange via the tool for the correct item IDs and order, resulting in an exchange request with a negative price difference (refund), and communicated accurate next steps and refund information. No fabricated information or policy violations are evident.
